# University of Miami Health System

> > Academic health system featuring the nation's #1 ranked eye hospital (Bascom Palmer Eye Institute) and NCI-designated Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing specialized patient care, research, and medical education.

University of Miami Health System integrates world-class clinical care with cutting-edge research and education. The system is home to Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, consistently ranked the top eye hospital by U.S. News & World Report, and Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, one of only 57 NCI-designated comprehensive cancer centers in the United States.

## Key Topics

- Bascom Palmer Eye Institute
- Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center
- Ophthalmology and eye care
- Cancer treatment and oncology
- NCI-designated cancer center
- Cancer survivorship and supportive care
- Multidisciplinary care
- U.S. News & World Report rankings
- Virtual eye care services
- Kenneth C. Griffin Cancer Research Building
- Ophthalmic education and research
- Patient-centered care
- Wellness clinics
- Academic medicine

## Major Clinical Centers

- [Bascom Palmer Eye Institute](https://umiamihealth.org/bascom-palmer-eye-institute): #1 ranked eye hospital offering comprehensive ophthalmology care & services
- [Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center](https://umiamihealth.org/sylvester-comprehensive-cancer-center): NCI-designated cancer center providing diagnosis, treatment & research

## Cancer Care and Survivorship

- [Cancer Survivorship and Supportive Care](https://umiamihealth.org/sylvester-comprehensive-cancer-center/cancer-survivorship-and-supportive-care/survivorship-wellness-clinics): Holistic cancer survivorship & wellness clinics at Sylvester Cancer Center
